silhouette.reason: Unmistakable grizzly: shoulder hump, dished face, round ears, heavy forelegs, short tail; the hump reads against the back line in SIDE.
fixes: break the outline with a few fur clumps on the hump and belly so it is not a smooth hull

proportions.reason: Ears now sit at a plausible size and the head, hump and leg masses match a grizzly photo by eye at 1.7 m.
fixes: thicken the forearms ~5% at the wrist for a heavier adult paw

materials.reason: The coat reads as grizzled fur and claws are pale keratin, but the closer hero.png exposes baked lighting in the albedo (a dark shadow band behind the hump, bright top-lit back), a stretched pale smear on the chest under the neck, and the claw scars are a flat lilac-pink like paint.
fixes: de-light the albedo (divide out the baked top light and the shadow band behind the hump)
repair the stretched texture on the chest under the neck
scars as darker, hairless pinkish-grey skin lines with fur parted round them, not lilac paint

detail.reason: Claws on each paw and fur grain hold in the closer hero, but the outline is still a smooth hull with no fur clumps on the back, belly fringe or legs, and the face has little plane structure.
fixes: a strand/shell or card pass on the back, belly fringe and backs of the forelegs so the outline breaks into fur clumps
sharper brow and muzzle planes in the Blender step (eye sockets, lip line)

wear.reason: Three claw scars on the shoulder and dark, wet lower legs tell a life outdoors; the dark legs end in a hard line like boots and the scars read painted.
fixes: feather the wet-leg darkening upward with clumped fur instead of a hard boot line
a rubbed patch on the flank and matted belly fur

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 is nearly indistinguishable from LOD0 at that distance: outline, colour blocks and scars hold.
fixes: drop LOD2 to ~3k triangles; the far view does not need 5k

technical.reason: QA clean; 30k / 10k / 5k triangles over 2 draws with idle, look and walk clips.
fixes: spend the LOD2 savings on the face at LOD0 (eye sockets, lips)
